headline.en: The lease broker that stops parallel coding agents from deadlocking.
headline.zh: 让并行 Coding Agent 不再互相死锁的租约仲裁器。

sub.en: Leasekeeper gives every agent a two-verb ownership API — acquire and release — over files, ports, GPUs and API quota. A wait-for graph refuses the circular wait before it locks up, so collisions are prevented instead of reconciled by hand.
sub.zh: Leasekeeper 为每个 Agent 提供两个动词的所有权接口 —— acquire 与 release —— 覆盖文件、端口、GPU 和 API 配额。等待图会在循环等待形成之前拒绝它，冲突被提前阻止，而不是事后手工收拾。

title.zh: 提前阻止，而非事后收拾

body.en: A circular wait is refused at acquire time and printed as b -> a -> b, instead of two agents hanging until a human notices.
body.zh: 循环等待在 acquire 阶段就被拒绝，并打印成 b -> a -> b，而不是两个 Agent 一直卡住等人发现。

title.en: One binary, one broker per run
title.zh: 单个二进制，每次运行一个 broker

body.en: No daemon and no database. The broker lives in memory for the length of your run, and every lease drops when it stops.
body.zh: 没有守护进程，也没有数据库。broker 只在这次运行期间存在于内存里，退出时所有租约一并失效。

body.en: Waiting is first-in-first-out. The agent queued first is served first once the holder releases, so concurrency keeps working instead of failing.
body.zh: 等待严格先来先服务。持有者释放后，最早排队的 Agent 先拿到租约，并发度得以保持，而不是直接失败。

title.zh: 两个 Agent 的循环等待，被拒绝

note.en: A real broker on a temporary socket plays the whole story in one process: no configuration and no second terminal.
note.zh: 一个真实的 broker 运行在临时 socket 上，在一个进程里演完整段故事：无需配置，也不需要第二个终端。

body.en: One process, one broker on a temporary socket. Agent a takes the file, agent b takes the port, a's request for the port waits, and b's request for the file is refused because it would close b -> a -> b.
body.zh: 一个进程，一个运行在临时 socket 上的 broker。Agent a 拿到文件，Agent b 拿到端口，a 请求端口时进入等待，而 b 请求文件时被拒绝，因为它会闭合 b -> a -> b。

a held half the pair and b held the other half, so the second acquire was refused
instead of hanging. Nothing was preempted: the refusal failed fast, and once b
released the port the queued waiter was served in order.

body.en: Build the binary, then run the built-in demo. It starts a broker on a temporary socket, plays the two-agent cycle and refuses the second acquire.
body.zh: 先构建二进制，然后运行内置 demo。它会启动一个临时 socket 上的 broker，演一遍两个 Agent 的循环等待，并拒绝第二次 acquire。

steps.code:
leasekeeper run --name a -- ./examples/agent-a.sh
leasekeeper run --name b -- ./examples/agent-b.sh

limitations.en: The broker is one local process per run on one host: no distributed leases and no cross-machine coordination.
limitations.zh: broker 是单机上每次运行一个本地进程：没有分布式租约，也没有跨机器协调。

limitations.en: An agent has to call acquire and release itself, or run under `leasekeeper run`. Kernel-level interception is out of scope for v0.1.
limitations.zh: Agent 必须自己调用 acquire 与 release，或者在 `leasekeeper run` 下运行。内核级拦截不在 v0.1 范围内。

limitations.en: GPU and quota are named resources an agent leases by agreement; Leasekeeper does not fence a driver or enforce VRAM.
limitations.zh: GPU 与配额是 Agent 通过约定租用的命名资源；Leasekeeper 不会在驱动层做隔离，也不强制显存配额。

limitations.en: If the broker dies, every lease drops. That is deliberate: no agent can hold a stale lease forever.
limitations.zh: broker 退出时所有租约失效。这是有意为之：任何 Agent 都无法永久持有一个过期租约。

caption.en: Leases and a wait-for graph, in one local binary
caption.zh: 租约与等待图，都在一个本地二进制里

body.en: You start a refactor, a test run and a GPU job against the same checkout. Each one wants a file, a port or a slice of quota, and nothing forces any of them to hold exclusive ownership before it writes. The parallelism you paid for turns into interference.
body.zh: 你在同一个检出上同时跑重构、测试和 GPU 任务。它们各自要一个文件、一个端口或一份配额，而没有任何机制要求它们在写入之前先取得独占所有权。你为并行付出的代价，变成了互相干扰。

body.en: One Go binary in three modes. `run` starts a broker and wraps your agent, `acquire` and `release` are the ownership API an agent calls, and `status` prints the table and the graph. The broker keeps the lease table and the wait-for graph in memory and serves both over a Unix socket.
body.zh: 一个 Go 二进制，三种模式。`run` 启动 broker 并包裹你的 Agent，`acquire` 与 `release` 是 Agent 调用的所有权接口，`status` 打印租约表与等待图。broker 在内存里维护租约表和等待图，并通过 Unix socket 对外服务。

image.alt: Leasekeeper's packages: the CLI, a Unix-socket client, the broker holding the lease table and the wait-for graph, and the lease and waitgraph primitives.

title.zh: 一次 acquire 发生了什么

body.en: The caller names the resource. The broker reads the lease table: if it is free the lease is granted and the owner recorded. If someone else holds it, the broker asks the wait-for graph whether making this agent wait would close a loop. It grants, queues or refuses — and a refusal names the cycle instead of blocking.
body.zh: 调用方声明资源名。broker 先查租约表：空闲就直接授予并记录持有者。若已被别人持有，broker 会问等待图：让这个 Agent 等待是否会闭合成环。结果是授予、排队或拒绝 —— 而拒绝会直接给出环，而不是继续阻塞。

image.alt: The acquire path: declare the resource, read the lease table, check the wait-for graph, then grant, queue or refuse with the cycle printed.

body.en: Four resource kinds ship in v0.1: file, port, gpu and quota. The kind is part of the name, so a file path can never collide with a port number. Agents reach the broker through the `leasekeeper run` wrapper, which puts the socket in the child's environment.
body.zh: v0.1 内置四种资源类型：file、port、gpu、quota。类型是资源名的一部分，因此文件路径永远不会和端口号冲突。Agent 通过 `leasekeeper run` 包装器访问 broker，它会把这个 socket 放进子进程的环境变量。

image.alt: The four leaseable resource kinds — file, port, gpu and quota — connected to the run wrapper and the Unix socket.

body.en: The second acquire fails fast with the cycle named, and exits non-zero so a script can branch on it.
body.zh: 第二次 acquire 会立即失败，并给出环的路径，同时以非零码退出，脚本可以据此分支。

details.code:
$ leasekeeper acquire file:src/a.go
acquire denied  acquire denied — would deadlock: b -> a -> b

body.en: Every lease names its owner, so `status` answers who holds what and who is waiting on whom.
body.zh: 每个租约都记录持有者，因此 `status` 能回答谁持有什么、谁在等谁。

details.code:
$ leasekeeper status
Leases
  RESOURCE       OWNER  HELD  TTL
  file:src/a.go  a      3s    -
  port:8080      b      2s    -
